paragraphs.text: School visits run from Tuesday to Friday and must be booked four weeks ahead. A visit lasts 90 minutes and includes the mill floor, where a machine from 1889 is started twice a day, at 11 am and 2 pm.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Groups of up to 30 pupils pay £45; larger groups are divided in two. Lunch may be eaten in the courtyard or, in bad weather, in the education room, which holds 40 people.
paragraphs.label: B

items.prompt: How far ahead must a school visit be booked?
How long does a visit last?
In which year was the mill machine made?
How many people can the education room hold?

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Find the answer in the text. You have 20 seconds for each question. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the text for each answer.
